bugs_found: file_matches_globs uses all() instead of any() — a path is reported as matching only when it matches EVERY pattern, which is virtually never true and inverts the intended OR-of-globs semantics
fnmatch '**' is not natively supported; only the special-cased '/**' suffix branch handles recursion, other '**' patterns fail silently
contract-presence flags __init__ and other dunders despite the inline comment claiming they are skipped — no skip code exists
floats-check regex hits inside strings/comments produce false positives that fail CI
review-gate 'resolved' summary count uses ('blocker',) tuple, omitting 'major' from the count even though the message says blocker/major
load_yaml_file is annotated -> dict but safe_load can return None/list, causing AttributeError when callers use .get()
review-gate dedup of findings by id relies on glob lexicographic order which can misorder rounds (e.g. round-10 < round-2)
